sprite.game: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty (2001)
sprite.incarnation: Original PS2 Fortune in-game no-coat costume and RG-590 railgun; Original MGS2 adult Black woman Fortune, dark brown complexion, muscular athletic build, long wavy swept-back platinum-blonde hair. Short black tux/white opaque shirt/navy bow/full trousers, native olive gloves/boots. Native massive olive RG590 receiver/twin open rails/squared muzzle gripped by two natural hands; not a conventional rifle. Corrected LEFT heel complete. No different age/incarnation.; original independently authored CQC gala adaptation, not a released canonical costume.
